slots.notes: Fullscreen fixed cinematic background video, object-fit cover, scroll-scrubbed: currentTime is driven by scroll fraction (top of page -> footer at 20vh) rather than auto-playing or looping. Must be seekable/keyframe-dense for smooth frame-by-frame scrubbing. Sits at z-0 behind all content.

Brand wordmark/logo, inlined SVG (native is 157x25, 4 white vector paths spelling 'WISA'). Reused in 3 places: fixed header (~25px tall), section 2 col 1 (scaled to 18px tall), and footer brand column (14px tall). Single-color, tinted via fg (white). Must scale crisply across those sizes.

Decorative wireframe globe mark beside the wordmark in section 2 col 1 (native 71x43 viewBox, stroke-only horizontal/vertical/meridian lines, no fill). Single stroke color (white). Optional/swappable brand motif slot.
Display + body sans typeface. Native is Manrope weights 300-700, loaded via Google Fonts @import and bound to --font-sans. Drives all headings (clamp-scaled) and body copy.

Monospace accent typeface for eyebrows, nav labels, button labels, footer headers, and copyright. Native is JetBrains Mono weights 400-700, loaded via Google Fonts @import and bound to --font-mono. Used at small tracked-out sizes (10-12px).

copySlots: hero-body (Advanced preparation and training of world-class football teams for leagues, tournaments, and trophies. We bring the trophy closer to your cabinet.)
scroll-reveal-body (Complete Football Programs For Professional Player Development. We Build The Foundations For Next-Generation Strikers, Midfielders, And Star Defenders.)
footer-cta-headline (Ready To Score / Your Winning Season?)

mechanic: A fixed cinematic background video is scroll-scrubbed (currentTime mapped to scroll fraction from page top to the footer at 20vh, guarded by video.seeking) beneath a layered, pointer-events-gated scroll stack whose hero/footer fade-rise into view and whose scroll-reveal section de-blurs and un-rotates GSAP-staggered word-by-word.
techDelivery: React 19 + Vite + Tailwind CSS v4 (@tailwindcss/vite), motion (framer-motion v12) for useScroll/useTransform + viewport reveals, GSAP ScrollTrigger for the word-reveal, lucide-react icons; fonts via Google Fonts @import and theme tokens in @theme; model-viewer 3.4.0 script included in head though unused.
reskinNotes:
Brand wordmark and globe are inlined SVGs with white fills/strokes baked into path markup (no fill currentColor), so recoloring requires editing the SVG, not just a token. The hero video URL is a hardcoded CloudFront constant and the asset must be specifically scrubbable/keyframe-dense, not just any clip. All copy is hardcoded in JSX (headlines use literal
line breaks, e.g. 'Championing'
'The Pitch Of Legends', and the hero body mixes a font-semibold white emphasis span inline). The footer is styled almost entirely with inline rgba/blur styles rather than tokens, so color-role swaps must also update those inline values. The scroll-scrub stop point and headerY transform use literal pixel thresholds (500/800/0.2vh) tuned to this layout. Two webfonts are pinned to specific weight ranges via the Google Fonts @import URL; swapping families means editing that import string.
